title: Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk

entities.name: Mitotic Slime
entities.description: An Ooze from Magic 2011 that splits into smaller Oozes when it dies; the columnist's favourite card of the set.

entities.name: Squadron Hawk
entities.description: A small bird creature from Magic 2011 that can be gathered in numbers and used as flyers, chump blockers or food for other creatures.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A Planeswalker whose mind-reading power is used as an example of the temptation to become an emotionless manipulator.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A hotheaded fire Planeswalker used as an example of power that must be tempered with discipline.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A Planeswalker whose raging, bellowing nature the columnist uses as a figure for his own wild side.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which Planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: Planeswalkers
entities.description: Beings whose spark lets them travel between planes; the columnist reflects on three trials they must survive.

events.summary: The columnist reflects that Mitotic Slime is his favourite Magic 2011 card and enjoys playing it in the office league.
events.quote: Playing "The Slime" in the inter-office M11 league has been a delight as it is bursting with flavor.

events.summary: The columnist drafts three Squadron Hawks for his tournament deck.
events.quote: By a stroke of luck, I drafted three of them for my tournament deck, which was pretty sweet.

events.summary: The columnist describes the first trial of a Planeswalker: surviving the ignition of the spark and the shock of planeswalking.
events.quote: Many potential Planeswalkers have been reduced to blathering vegetables, lost in the Blind Eternities, or have just had their brains and hearts explode due to the stresses put upon them.

events.summary: He describes the second trial: surviving the social reaction if a Planeswalker reveals their power.
events.quote: To reveal one's spark is risky business to say the least.

events.summary: He describes the third trial, illustrated by Jace's path toward either an emotionless manipulator or a wise mage.
events.quote: Follow a Planeswalker's path, like Jace's, and you'll see his struggle with becoming an emotionless manipulator who uses his power to get what he wants or a wise and worldly mage who helps others and knows the difference between truth and illusion.

events.summary: He asks whether Chandra will sink into impulsiveness or temper her emotions with discipline.
events.quote: Will Chandra sink into impulsiveness and callous disregard for life or will she temper her hotheaded emotions with a bit of discipline or by thinking first and acting from wisdom?

events.summary: The columnist makes friends with the censor-bots rather than letting his inner Garruk destroy them.
events.quote: I did manage to not let my inner Garruk run wild and destroy the censor-bots ...
